newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom shares start lower after Bonn deal.
newsitem.headline: Telekom shares start lower after Bonn deal.

text.p: Shares in Deutsche Telekom AG, the German telecoms giant, started IBIS Dax trade 1.36 percent lower on Thursday after news a deal had been reached with the government to transfer Telekom shares to a state development agency.
The shares, which ended Wednesday's IBIS trade at 42.78 marks, opened at 42.20 marks, but swiftly recovered some opening losses and were trading at 42.45 marks by 0641 GMT.

Telekom said earlier that it had agreed a deal by which the government will transfer 25 percent of its total capital in Telekom to the state development agency Kreditanstalt fuer Wiederaufbau (KfW) in two steps in 1997 and 1998.
Telekom is due to hold a shareholder meeting in Frankfurt later on Thursday.
